{{Quote|We just got a break that could make this the hottest spot on Hoth.|Vinson|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Vinson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[Outpost Cresh]], where he asked a Republic citizen to check up the location provided by a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who prepared to defect from the Imperial Intelligence with sensitive information.<ref name="TOR" />
